evidence: primary_a1_containment_replay.log: both misses start on Box B patch 1188 (slots 76036, 76037) at grazing outgoing angle. primary_a1_wall_edge_probe.log: the right wall is hit by axis-aligned probes at every offset down to y = -2 (no geometric slit). primary_a1_ray_retrace.log: from the spawned origin both rays cross x = 2 at y = -2.0000074 and -2.0000423, i.e. 7 and 42 micrometres outside the right wall's front edge (genuine escapes at the right-wall/open-face corner); aiming 1 mm inside the edge hits the wall. primary_a1_containment_spawn_origin_check.log: with the spawned origin, replica 0 classifies {opening 53869656, seam 18, tangency 1315, unexplained 0}.
cause: Instrument defect in WL101G's containment classifier: room_exit used the un-offset surface point hit.p while the visibility ray was traced from hit.spawn_ray(w).o (~0.2 mm normal offset). At grazing incidence on the right wall (w.x ~ 0.2) the offset moves the analytic wall crossing ~1 mm along the wall.
change: gpu101g.construct: room_exit(spawned.o, w, ...) instead of room_exit(hit.p, w, ...).
unchanged: Every tolerance and gate (unexplained == 0, seam and tangency <= 2e-5, edge band 1e-3 m, opening tolerance 1e-3 m), the tangency rule, Amendment 1, seeds, spp, views, measures and analysis.
